scheme_name: Financial Assistance for Registered Fishermen Society
other_conditions: Society must be a fisheries co‑operative society/association registered with the Fisheries Co‑operative Societies
Society must produce an audited statement of accounts
Society must employ at least one personnel for the maintenance of records
Society must produce books of accounts for inspection when called for by department authorities
Society must have more than 25 members
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of up to ₹50,000 as a grant‑in‑aid.
documents_required: Prescribed format of the application form
Copies of all mandatory documents (self‑attested, if required)
